[EN] If you knew what we risked by fighting alongside your federation, you wouldn't glare at me with disdain.

We're doing what we must to save our people, to save Sikander. If we fail, we might well lose both!
[ES] Si supieras lo que arriesgamos al luchar junto a tu federation, no me mirarías con desdén.

Estamos haciendo lo necesario para salvar a nuestra gente, para salvar a Sikander. ¡Si fallamos, bien podríamos perder a ambos!
